name: fireguard-api-lsp
description: FireGuard API language server — Intelephense on .php. Ships nothing but .lsp.json and the launcher that resolves the app at runtime, because LSP configuration is the one Claude Code component that loads exclusively from an *enabled plugin*: the fireguard-api plugin is deliberately disabled inside the app (its .claude/ already loads natively there), so the server needs its own plugin to be available from both the monorepo root and the app itself.
